svg.title: Voice assistant: speak, understand, decide, respond, confirm
svg.text: A voice request never changes data by itself
The assistant only navigates to an allow-list of screens, shows every answer, and waits for the server to confirm.

g.text: Opens Mandi prices — an allow-listed screen
Opens the jobs map — answer spoken and shown
Reads the balance shown on screen
Asks to confirm, then waits for the server
